description: Whoscall Lens helps you instantly detect scam risks hidden in images using Whoscall’s extensive database of phone numbers, URLs, and anti-scam intelligence. Simply upload a screenshot or photo to receive a detailed scam risk report, including real scam cases, community discussions, and relevant warnings related to the content in your image. Whether it’s a suspicious message, an unfamiliar website, or an unknown contact, Whoscall Lens gives you the insights you need to make smarter, safer decisions.
